## ARCH-2 Step 1 (simplify first): verdicts

The dedicated research pass on whether the general problem can be reduced further is done. Full verdict document with all numbers, provenance, and citations: `docs/research/global-solver-2026-08/ARCH2-STEP1-SIMPLIFY.md`. Method: 5 web field surveys + 2 code/corpus clusters + a dedicated costate analysis, delegator-run measurements (new j003 struct export, COPT sphere/disk sweeps, python probes under `research/step1/`), then an adversarial consolidation. Headline: **two of the design's three headline levers are measured dead as stated, and the front-door formulation changes**; what survives is the continuous kernel plus exactly the stack the no-turn PoC already proved out.

### Per-hypothesis verdicts

- **H1 gate near-determinism via chain FBBT: DEAD.** Forward+backward interval propagation leaves k ~ 2(n-1) gates ambiguous at the root on every one of 30 corpus structs (j1150 90, j021 76, j153 166), and 175/176 on j003, vs the designed k <= 6. Structural: the relaxation's velocity disk contains the origin, and |v| >= eps is a nonconvex bound FBBT cannot express. Gate determinism is real but comes from incumbent-driven **gate-pattern folding** (the PoC fixed-point loop, fidelity 1.3e-2 -> 1.5e-4 in 2 rounds), which the robotics literature names Staged Contact Optimization; a replay-falsified fold reopens into the 3-way branch. FBBT demotes to node arc tightening.
- **H2 bucket-window: SIMPLIFIES, basin-local only.** Cross-family, the continuous optimum sits hundreds-to-thousands of buckets from the byte-exact solution (measured W_p90 up to 6002); within a fixed family it is 0-2 buckets (loopmm: W=0 on 90% of ticks). Leaf window: 1-3 buckets on 26.x, up to +-50 on legacy (float sine pair-norm noise 4.8e-5). Bucket enumeration is valid only AFTER structure commitment, and the leaf must scan a window, never snap nearest.
- **H3 costate collapse: SIMPLIFIES with hard limits.** The pointwise Hamiltonian argmax is real (adjoint recursion verified against the code chain to 6e-12; walls superpose truncated chains; post-last-wall ticks pin outright). But the "strong feasible incumbent from tick 0" is unsound: measured on 7 captures the costate controls violate walls by 0.08..12.29 blocks. The CostateDualSolver pgres ~2.4 plateau is structural (pgres is a recovery meter; at the kink some g_t = 0 and no multiplier yields a feasible full-modulus recovery; reproduced in pure python, floor frozen over 300k iterations while the dual value is tight to 1e-3). Keep: node-level dive at depth, tail pinning, dual value as anytime bound. Never gate anything on pgres.
- **H4 velocity-window MITM: split.** State-chained receding-horizon windows (LongRunSolver, already built) are the scaling lever. The enumerated 2D entry-velocity grid is dead at byte-exact precision: 6.5-10.1x interface amplification forces ~1e-5 resolution (~5e9 cells), the reachable interface set is sparse-discrete, and the objective is not a function of interface velocity alone. VelocityFinder fields demote to coarse filter + warm start.
- **H5 grammar: SIMPLIFIES.** Fresh parse of the 5206-unique-text strat corpus: 88.6% hit the 10-family grammar, 97.8% within 1-4 families (~93-95% effective after parser slack). The outer search proposes from dozens of templates ranked by the existing library.json prior; Stratfinder independently validates family-first search.
- **H6 easiness-first: SIMPLIFIES.** 88.2% of the 34 human byte-exact witnesses are easy-class (<= 6 edges, single sprint engage, <= 2 setup facings), 58.8% pure no-turn, sneak 0/34; raw TAS captures are a separated population (13.8% easy, 0% no-turn). Easy-first with escalation on certified infeasibility is sound (witnesses prove containment). Cold DISCOVERY of the easy structure remains the open piece: the structure-pool driver.
- **H7 one certified translation layer: DEAD in the strong form.** Clamp-free error ~1e-2 on gate-active jumps; even folded, the 1.5e-4 residual exceeds the 9e-5 knife-edge corridor (walls ridden at e-6). The working contract is anchor-local: per-wall signed SLP margins re-anchored per round, bucket-exact constants, collision clearance >= 2e-6 in the solve, ExactJumpModel replay as the only certificate.
- **H8 symmetry/legality dedup: SIMPLIFIES (outer).** Sprint latch 2^n -> n+1 (1e13 cut on j1150), edge caps 9^n -> ~1e8 (1e38 cut); 45-degree relabel only /4; inner solver absorbs it.

### The reduction stack

1. Scope split: angle solving and stratfinding stay separate problems. The inner ARCH-2 solver takes fixed inputs and finds facings only; the grammar / easy-class results (H5, H6, H8) belong exclusively to the OUTER no-turn stratfinder layer, where the schedule is the search object (proposals from 10-family templates in the no-turn MIQCP shape, escalating to free facing on certified infeasibility). On the inner side the j003 finding means something else: its disk optimum is modulus-interior on ALL 176 ticks, so with fixed keys the byte-exact realization is facing chatter, the costate is silent everywhere, and those arcs are exactly what the B&B must branch. No input search applies to j003.
2. Gates: fold from incumbents to a fixed point; branch 3-way only what replay falsifies plus the low-velocity tail.
3. Branch on: angle arcs (chord + tangent cuts, ordered by the disk solve's own throttled-tick geography) and residual gates. No pseudocosts.
4. Continuous kernel: DiskSocpKernel + chord cut, IPM at nodes (disk-vs-sphere <= 1.6e-3 corpus-wide; j003 continuous solves in 0.33 s). The k-gon dual simplex demotes to build-on-measured-need.
5. Incumbents: wall homotopy (= Scholtes continuation, the only measured cold-discovery mechanism on knife edges) + MIP starts + folding; costate as dive/bound only.
6. Translation: anchor-local SLP margins, replay is the certificate (gap=0 on the finite grid).
7. Leaf: bucket-window scan + pinned walk + ulp nudge (RENS-style).
8. Long runs: LongRunSolver state chaining.
9. The one new build: the **structure-pool driver** (one-tree no-good cuts + proximity search for min-edges + switching-cost rounding MIP starts + homotopy tightener).

### What this design can DROP

FBBT-as-gate-fixer; the costate warm start as the incumbent source; free-per-tick-facing as the default formulation; the k-gon dual-simplex node engine (demoted); reliability pseudocosts; the single rigorous a-priori translation layer; enumerated velocity-window interfaces; nearest-bucket leaf snapping; the GCS/Lagrangian half of the escalation item; and the two claimed COPT-beating edges built on the first two items. Surviving edges: certified byte-exact gap=0, pure Java 8, and the fold/homotopy/replay driver COPT lacks (0 incumbents in 500k+ nodes cold).

Main residual risks: modern-gate evidence is essentially one capture (j003); H4's certificate-level windowing check and the pool driver are unbuilt; homotopy has no coverage guarantee; the fold encodes only the zero side of the pattern; no ARCH-2-style fixed-input solve of j003 (fold + tail gate branching + bucket-window leaf) has been run yet, and the STEP-9 regression stays open until that stack lands.

Next: Step 2, component inventory against this reduced design.
